quiz.title: Bergen QTI Compatibility Check
quiz.instructions: Answer all five questions. This quiz uses synthetic course content and contains no student information.

questions.title: Primary source
questions.prompt: Which item is a primary source for studying a historical event?

choices.text: A diary written during the event

questions.title: Source evaluation
questions.prompt: The author and purpose of a source can affect how the source should be interpreted.

questions.title: Credibility checks
questions.prompt: Which actions help evaluate the credibility of a source? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Assume the first search result is accurate
Compare the claim with other reliable sources

questions.title: Source type
questions.prompt: What term describes evidence created during the time being studied?

questions.title: Evidence explanation
questions.prompt: In two or three sentences, explain why corroborating a source can strengthen an argument.
questions.feedback: Evaluate the explanation for a clear reason and an accurate connection to corroboration.
